title: Provide a live incident briefing across operational systems

requirement.userGoal: Allow approved agent hosts to retrieve current alerts, deploys, support trends, and incident decisions through one governed interface.
requirement.freshnessObjective: Operational evidence no more than two minutes old.

existingCapabilities.name: Vendor-specific incident connectors
existingCapabilities.gap: No single connector covers the required systems or provides a shared schema and tenant policy.

existingCapabilities.name: Direct service APIs
existingCapabilities.gap: Each host would need separate credentials, integration code, schemas, and audit handling.

advantages: Creates a shared typed capability surface with central credentials, scope, and audit.
limitations: Introduces a production service with availability and support obligations.

advantages: Uses supported identity and consent paths.
limitations: Available connectors do not cover the full evidence set.

advantages: Can package the briefing procedure and interpretation guidance.
limitations: Cannot provide current state, central credentials, or server-side authorisation by itself.

correctnessBoundaries.rule: The caller may retrieve only incidents and tenants allowed by current identity policy.
correctnessBoundaries.failureBehaviour: Return an explicit authorisation failure without querying restricted sources.

correctnessBoundaries.rule: The briefing must distinguish confirmed evidence from generated interpretation.
correctnessBoundaries.failureBehaviour: Mark unsupported sections as unavailable instead of presenting them as facts.

decision.rationale: Live state, cross-host reuse, typed schemas, central credentials, tenant policy, and structured audit make the protocol boundary materially valuable.

rejectedAlternatives.reason: No supported connector covers the required systems and shared policy.
A skill can package the briefing workflow but cannot supply the governed live capabilities.
